ns2:section.sectionText: This is a reading, seminar, and project based course on the intersection of baseball and statistics. In this course you will learn how to conduct relevant data analyses with a focus on how to quantify aspects of baseball play associated with winning games. You will also learn about the statistical history of baseball with an emphasis on comparing players across eras. Founding principles as well as advanced statistical methods for both directions will be discussed. The analyses that you conduct will also develop your critical thinking skills as a statistician. Furthermore, practical advantages, limitations, and comparisons of methods will be discussed. If you are interested in quantifying how good Mike Trout is or in ranking the careers of Barry Bonds, Willie Mays, and Babe Ruth, then this is the course for you. Prerequisites: STAT 385 and STAT 410
